messages.subject: latexmk?
parts:
Anyone have any experience with latexmk?

I'm thinking of using that to build our manual. It'll handle dependencies a lot more generally than whatever dependency rules I can make.

Here's how to run it. From within src/docs/stan-reference/:
> latexmk -pdf -pdflatex="pdflatex -interactive=nonstopmode" -use-make src/docs/stan-reference/stan-reference.tex


It would add an additional dependency on Perl for anyone that wants to build the manual. On Mac and Linux, I don't think that's an issue. On Windows, it's not part of anything we suggest people to install, but this is really a dev-only procedure. Anyone downloading a tarball will have the built pdf.




Daniel
